monitorActions.label: No action
monitorActions.description: Take no action; the PAT is progressing normally or an alert would add noise.

monitorActions.label: Notify submitter
monitorActions.description: Tell the submitter the PAT is at risk, which gate is blocking it and what they can do.

monitorActions.label: Nudge approval group
monitorActions.description: Send a reminder to the blocking approval group's mailbox that a time-sensitive PAT is waiting.

monitorActions.label: Escalate to backup
monitorActions.description: Escalate to the blocking group's backup contacts. Only for critical PATs; a person must confirm first.

advisorActions.label: Submit as soon as possible
advisorActions.description: Every hour of lead time increases the chance all gates finish before the event.

advisorActions.label: Verify event details
advisorActions.description: Check event time, time zone, venue and speaker so reviewers don't send it back.

advisorActions.label: Confirm disclosures
advisorActions.description: Make sure all required disclosures are attached before submitting.

advisorActions.label: Review securities and issuers
advisorActions.description: Check the list of securities, issuers and sovereign entities is complete and accurate; these drive Control Group review time.

advisorActions.label: Narrow the scope
advisorActions.description: If some securities or entities are not essential to the appearance, removing them can shorten review.

advisorActions.label: Enable monitoring
advisorActions.description: Turn on Approval Intelligence alerts for this PAT.

advisorActions.label: Give Control Group a heads-up
advisorActions.description: Let the Control Group mailbox know a time-sensitive PAT is coming.

advisorActions.label: Respond quickly to reviewer questions
advisorActions.description: Reply to reviewer questions the same day to avoid losing queue position.
